verdict.rationale: A skills or plugins registry with one-step install is a fair question for an agent framework, but the evidence shows no such registry. Mastra offers a templates gallery of complete projects to clone and adapt, and tools are added by importing code into the agent constructor. Both are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not a browsable capability registry with one-command or one-click install.

support.subject: As a power user, I can browse a real skills/plugins registry and install a capability with one command or click
